messages:
lina_csm: FYI Azura Commerce just signaled a big expansion — two new product teams (search relevancy + in-cart personalization) want to go live. They expect ~3x peak QPS for checkout-time scoring. Need capacity plan + enablement.

mike_azura: correct. Search team will run nightly reindex embeddings (est. 400k docs) and realtime reranks at query time. Personalization needs sub-150ms tail latency for cart suggestions. Pilot target in 4 weeks.

raj_solutions: i'll lead enablement. Can they share sample query distributions and embedding dims? Any compliance flags?

mike_azura: embedding dim = 768, avg doc tokens ~300. Queries skew: 70% short (<64 tokens), 30% long (up to 1.2k). No regulated PII; session ids only.

noah_prodeng: For 3x we should test two approaches: (A) Dedicated reserved + burst credits, (B) Hosted with aggressive batching + prefix cache. Early calc says dedicated with auto-burst is safer for latency SLO.

emma_research: For embeddings, recommend quantized int8 + a vector index pre-shard. I can produce perf matrix comparing 16-bit vs int8 for recall/latency tradeoffs.

olivia_sales: procurement asked if Azura would consider a 6-12mo commit if pricing predictable. I'll confirm willingness once we have a committed units estimate from infra.

infra-bot: [notice] cluster autoscaler engaged for org azura-corp: +3 nodes allocated in region us-west-2.

noah_prodeng: Quick pilot config to try (use on staging):\n```\nservice: azura-personalization\nreplicas: 4\ngpu_per_replica: 1\nbatching:\n  enabled: true\n  max_batch_size: 64\n  max_latency_ms: 10\nkv_cache: true\n```\nStart with 4x replicas and measure. With KV caching we should hit tail latency targets for short queries.

raj_solutions: i'll set up a 90min enablement session w/ playbook and eval harness. Will request sample payloads for load test.

emma_research: adding model suggestions: low-latency 8k context model for personalization + int8 embedding model. I'll attach perf numbers to the runbook.

olivia_sales: action items recapped: (1) infra estimate + committed units (noah) (2) enablement + eval harness (raj) (3) model perf + quantization plan (emma) (4) procurement pricing dance (olivia).

eng-oncall: noted. we'll monitor us-west-2 cluster and keep standby capacity during the pilot window. please tag us with exact start times.

mike_azura: Pilot window proposal: Mon 5/10 - Thu 5/13. We'll provide data access and sample traffic by next Tue.

olivia_sales: i'll schedule procurement sync after we have the capacity estimate. Good signal for renewal (renewal Q3).

lina_csm: I'll update account health to "expansion opportunity: high" and link the runbook when it's ready. Thanks team :thumbsup:
